environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching request query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:['";]\s*(?:INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|UNION|SELECT|ALTER|CREATE|EXEC))` at priority 1 with BLOCK action, and (2) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 2 with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no IAM permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents — the SQLite DB is on ephemeral task storage (no persistent exfiltration path). CloudWatch Logs Insights query runs every 5 minutes alerting on WAF BLOCK events.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights alert on WAF BLOCK actions every 5 minutes
config.database: SQLite on ephemeral Fargate task storage (lost on task restart)
